messages:
Maya K: Canary at 5% in eu-west-3 reporting p95 tail jump ~10m after cutover. Holding at 5% per rollout runbook. @Sam can you take a look? :eyes:
Sam: On it, pulling telemetry and traces now. Any infra changes?
Devon: No infra deploys. Noticed the model shard rebalancer ran recently though. Could be unrelated.
ops-bot: ALERT: canary-eu5 latency anomaly detected. p95 130ms -> 560ms. 5xx unchanged.
Sam: Seeing GC spikes on eu5-host-07 and eu5-host-08 and elevated KV eviction counts.
Maya K: Sounds like noisy hosts. Options: 1) route canary slice off those hosts (preferred), 2) rollback to previous build, 3) pin to alternate region. Thoughts?
Nina: Route-override first. Minimizes telemetry loss and is quick to revert.
Sam: I'll run a routing override excluding the two hosts. If routing change fails or error budget >20% then we roll back.
Devon: Also add a temporary autoscale buffer to absorb misses while we swap.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: requested action: route-override apply --selector canary:v2026-03-11 --exclude-hosts eu5-host-07,eu5-host-08 --until 1796015000
deploy-bot: status: routing-change job rchg-9023 started
Sam: Patch applied to 3 of 4 canary instances; one failed with socket timeout, retrying now.
ops-bot: INFO: rchg-9023 progress: 3 success, 1 retry pending
Sam: Retry succeeded. All canary instances now off the two noisy hosts. Re-evaluating p95...
Sam: p95 back to ~140ms. KV evictions trending down. No uptick in 5xx.
Maya K: Good. Let's extend observation window by 20m before ramping to 20%. Update change window and annotate release notes: "Extended canary observation by 20m due to transient eu5 host instability; routing override applied."
Nina: Please file a maintenance ticket for the two hosts (INC-7349) to reprovision/drain.
Sam: Opening ticket INC-7349 -> reprovision eu5-host-07, eu5-host-08. I'll close after schedule confirmed.
Devon: Will monitor autoscale behavior during the extended window.
ops-bot: NOTE: Canaries held at 5% until 1796016200 per updated window.
Maya K: Thanks team. No rollback needed at this time. Resuming slow ramp after 20m stable window. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rchg-9023 completed at 1796011222
Sam: Closing thread once INC-7349 scheduled.
Maya K: Closing for now, reopen if we see regressions.
